caption: The drawing features a repeating pattern on a light blue background with black and white illustrations. The scene includes a central figure of a muscular man holding a staff, standing next to a rectangular pedestal with a bird perched on top and an inscription visible on the pedestal. There are winged human figures (possibly angels) kneeling or sitting near the pedestal and staff-bearing man. Additionally, there are children or cherubs playing in small groups, often near small leafy bushes, and a ship with sails depicted in the background, partly surrounded by water or land. Sparse tufts of grass and trees are scattered throughout the scene. On the right edge, there is a vertical strip of blue with a decorative white pattern.
title: Wall Paper and Border
